criterion.description: A synthesized gesture passes only when held-out repetition recall is at least 80% and nearest-rival Fisher separation exceeds its one-to-one matched catalogue gesture.

caveat: Simulated babble and simulated users. Fatigue accrual is a simulator assumption proportional to excitation, so the fatigue term largely duplicates effort here. Learnability (teach-back) is not measured. Not a human result.
